messages:
maya: Calliope8b bench done. Need a short GTN recommendation: int6 vs int8 vs int4 tradeoffs, routing flag, and canary plan.

diego: Quick numbers (40k token smoke): p95 latency int8=125ms, int6=118ms, int4=108ms. Throughput up ~10% on int4. Unit cost est: int8 $0.0010/token, int6 $0.00075/token, int4 $0.0005/token (batched + KV-cache assumptions).

lina-qa: Quality notes: longform QA (>512 tokens) EM deltas vs int8: int6 -1.2pt, int4 -4.8pt. Hallucination +0.6ppt int6, +1.9ppt int4. Short prompts (<=64) negligible diffs.

sam: My read for GTN: default to int6 as a balanced default (most customers keep UX, meaningful cost reduction). Offer int4 as opt-in for short, low-value flows. Keep int8 for critical retrieval or longform routes.

aj: Ops suggestion: enable KV-cache warmstarts and prefix-cache for retrieval-heavy routes; this recovers ~30-40% of priming token cost and narrows EM gap. Also test a per-layer mixed quant variant if needed.

diego: Minimal routing flag proto (hand-off to infra):
{
  "routes": [
    {"id":"short_lowcost","match":"tokens<=64 && metadata.tier=='low'","model":"calliope8b-int4","sample_rate":0.05},
    {"id":"balanced","match":"tokens>64 && tokens<=512","model":"calliope8b-int6","sample_rate":0.9},
    {"id":"longform","match":"tokens>512","model":"calliope8b-int8","sample_rate":0.05}
  ],
  "fallbacks": [{"from":"calliope8b-int4","to":"calliope8b-int6","triggers":["quality_drop","timeout"]}]
}

maya: ops-bot canary window?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Proposed canary: 2h window tomorrow 04:00 UTC on eng-dedicated-calliope. Canary split: int6 default, int4 sample 5% on short_lowcost. Rollback triggers: EM regression >2% on any slice or p95 latency increase >25%.

lina-qa: Canary test plan: slices = [short snippets <=64, mid-length summarization 128-512, longform QA >512]. Metrics = exact-match, hallucination rate, p95, token-cost delta. AB 24h with automated pivot.

sam: GTN blurb: "Recommend calliope8b-int6 as default (good cost/quality balance). Enable int4 opt-in for short low-risk flows to capture up to ~40% token cost savings vs int8. Retain int8 for longform/retrieval-critical routes until further quant improvements."

maya: Action items: diego open routing PR with snippet, lina run overnight expanded slices and post CSV, I'll watch canary and call rollback if thresholds trip. Thanks :thumbsup:
